citation: Christensen et al. 2026. Differences in physiological response to an oral glucose tolerance test in adult Maasai men and women. Acta Diabetologica 63:1363.
protocol: 75 g glucose in 300 mL water; blood at 0, 10, 30, 60, 90, 120 min
population: 58 adult Maasai without diabetes (29 men, 29 women), rural Tanzania
note: Rare non-Western African cohort with five hormones, split by sex. The table prints only fasting and 2-h values (a few columns give 95% CI ranges instead of SD; check header per row); the time course and AUCs are in figures.
